C1a-05 opens (pass 5). Views after pass 4's close (c1_views_diff.py): 10,587 placements against 13,365 on the settled line; 194 themes placed; T3-084 76 placements (82 settled), after the floor took off 16 thin additions; placed nowhere T3-140 (rare since pass 4), T3-144, T3-161; one room: T3-007, T3-025, T3-067, T3-077, T3-106, T3-128, T3-133, T3-186, T3-197 (all rare); T3-125 and T3-191 now in two. Declared before the draw, for the revision rate (section 3): 200 second-order themes drawn from assign_final.jsonl's keys, sorted, by Python random.Random(20261013).sample; each re-decided by me from all its concepts under scheme_v2, the reading rules and J's floor, without looking at which theme the readers chose first. The rate is the share I would place differently from the settled line, reported with mean Jaccard and primary agreement (notes-B2's declarations), and again against the current line. Each difference is classed: a theme of the line that takes no concept or a different primary (moved, an error under scheme_v2); a second act of three concepts or more the line lacks (the lean J ruled on: measured, not moved, QC1-002); a second theme of the line below the floor (measured, not moved: J's floor was written for adding, and no sweep); April Fools, visitor and named-words gates (as written).
